title: Fruza Watermelon Bubble Blast 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Fruza's Watermelon Bubble Blast is a fun and fruity confectionery blend. This flavour combines the fresh, juicy taste of sweet Watermelon with a classic, sugary Bubblegum base. It's a playful and nostalgic vape that balances authentic fruit notes with a sweet finish. The Fruza shortfill range is crafted for vapers seeking clear, intense, and authentic flavours. Inspired by Japanese precision and artistry, each e-liquid features a double concentration of flavour, designed to provide a rich and punchy taste experience. With a 50% VG / 50% PG blend, this e-liquid is formulated for MTL vaping. It’s ideal for use with Starter vape kits and pod mods, producing dense, satisfying clouds and exceptional flavour clarity. This 100ml shortfill is supplied in a 120ml bottle, containing 100ml of 0mg e-liquid. This leaves the perfect amount of space to add two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing you to create 120ml of 3mg nicotine-strength e-liquid. All Fruza e-liquids are made in the UK, TPD-compliant, and feature a childproof cap and a tamper-evident seal for your safety.
